body: better not add a tableName but avoid `$query = static::find();` and make it explicit with the model name. calling find on the searchModel will return not records of the original model class but of the serchmodel which is wrong.
@cebe All we need to do is just move tableName() to `User` model like for all generated model and all be fine.

@creocoder are you aware of the fact that you then get models of type MyModelSearch instead of MyModel? Search should only be the model for input validation of the search form, not the result of the search itself.

@cebe If you suggest go explicit way that this is about https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/pull/4037 . I can reopen it. But there is drawbacks, non using `static` also have BIG drawbacks. Current solution seems balanced.
